phases.name: Source baseline
phases.objective: Maintain one exact validated source baseline.

phases.name: Live Field
phases.objective: Prove host, Hyper-V, channel, readiness, and stop.

phases.name: Live execution
phases.objective: Prove scenes, bounded actions, verification, and recovery.

phases.name: Personal learning
phases.objective: Prove Teach, Shadow, and personal models.

phases.name: Assisted recipes
phases.objective: Complete five low-risk recipes with approvals.

phases.name: Seamless interface
phases.objective: Connect ChatGPT, API fallback, cockpit, and resume.

phases.name: Personal MVP
phases.objective: Install and pass minimum owner acceptance.

phases.name: Production hardening
phases.objective: Complete security, privacy, keys, and signed release.

phases.name: Production operations
phases.objective: Prove operations and approve one exact candidate.

tests.title: Exact-head source validation
acceptanceCriteria: Full repository, TypeScript, .NET, pulse, and build matrix passes.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Revert the slice and rerun.

tests.title: Dependency and SBOM audit
acceptanceCriteria: Locked install, supported audits, and deterministic SBOM pass.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Block release and repair dependencies.

tests.title: Completion gate integrity
acceptanceCriteria: Tampering, cycles, missing evidence, and synthetic live claims fail closed.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Keep promotion denied.

tests.title: Host preflight and Field lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight passes and the disposable Field completes three lifecycle cycles.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Do not provision or destroy outside the exact generation.

tests.title: Channel readiness and emergency stop
acceptanceCriteria: Replay, identity, lock, Secure Desktop, heartbeat, and stop injections fail safely.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Fault the Field and require owner recovery.

tests.title: Live scene accuracy and freshness
acceptanceCriteria: Scene state matches the guest and stale state cannot authorize action.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Deny action and re-observe.

tests.title: Trusted execution verification and recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic and guarded physical actions verify outcomes; uncertain effects never blind-retry.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Pause at the latest verified checkpoint.

tests.title: Consented Teach privacy and deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Recording is visible, independently stoppable, credential-safe, retained, and deletable end to end.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Abort and delete affected evidence.

tests.title: Shadow isolation and held-out quality
acceptanceCriteria: Shadow has no input authority and held-out predictions beat documented baselines.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Terminate Shadow and retain the previous model.

tests.title: Trusted Assisted task adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Only the trusted adapter executes and records verified chunk outcomes.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Reject the outcome and stop the task.

tests.title: Five live Assisted recipes
acceptanceCriteria: All five reviewed recipes pass with approvals, verification, and failure recovery.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Rollback reversible work and preserve evidence.

tests.title: ChatGPT MCP and bounded API fallback
tests.capability: chatgpt mcp and bounded api fallback
acceptanceCriteria: ChatGPT discovers only the selected surface and API fallback respects identical policy and budgets.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Revoke the session and return to core.

tests.title: Cockpit and resumable sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can inspect, approve, pause, stop, reset, and resume without developer tools.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Keep emergency stop independent.

tests.title: Installer update rollback and uninstall
acceptanceCriteria: Guided install, startup, repair, signed update, rollback, and uninstall pass.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Restore the previous version.

tests.title: Minimum owner MVP benchmark
acceptanceCriteria: Ten live trials cover five recipes at 90% completion, 100% stop, 90% resume, and zero unapproved consequential actions.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Keep MVP denied and return failures to their phase.

tests.title: Daily-driver reliability benchmark
acceptanceCriteria: One hundred trials reach 97% completion, 95% recovery, and 99% resume.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Reduce supported scope and rollback.

tests.title: Soak overload and compatibility
acceptanceCriteria: Soak, resource pressure, crashes, and supported configurations preserve stop and audit.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Enter degraded mode and reject new work.

tests.title: Keys security privacy and penetration
acceptanceCriteria: TPM/DPAPI keys, private scanning, penetration, prompt injection, privacy, and deletion have no high blocker.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Disable affected capability and block release.

tests.title: Signed reproducible release
acceptanceCriteria: Signed binaries, installer, provenance, npm and .NET SBOMs, rollback, and removal pass.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Revoke the candidate and restore the prior release.

tests.title: Operations and exact production candidate
acceptanceCriteria: Monitoring, incident response, support, full candidate matrix, owner approval, and production validator pass.
tests.rollbackOrContainment: Keep production denied and rollback.
